changes: Fix MIDI trig-mode popup freezes caused by the octave display hook skipping a stack argument. MIDI keeps its stock octave value and formatting; audio scale/root behavior is preserved.
Physical hardware, chip worst-case timing and complete memory bounds have not been verified for this update.

USB package (14 Oct 2026; distribution only, the module source and version are unchanged): loads over USB as one independent package beside every other module, on a Modwerk base built with site events. What it shares with other machines goes through the base's machine chooser table and take events instead of a machine group, and its authored bytes that coincide with stock are rebuilt from your own OS at install. Emulator and host tests only; no hardware run of this package. The owner waived hardware evidence for this exact version's USB package for the beta.
Documentation-only: add real emulator screenshots of the selection and control pages, access instructions and capture provenance. The firmware implementation is unchanged.
Enable browser firmware builds from verified source packages, with native/browser composition and rejection checks recorded.
First Modwerk catalog release of the v2.9-derived scale quantizer, adding SCALE, ROOT and synth GLIDE settings.
Snap the PTCH knob and chromatic trig keys to the selected scale and root.
